analysis.label: Data Analysis
analysis.intro: Statistics on real project data: query it, test an experiment, compare survival curves, audit amounts, tune fraud rules and segment customers. Each test is rerun on this page and checked against the Python libraries the projects use.

engineering.label: Data Engineering
engineering.intro: How data is moved, checked, versioned, streamed and scheduled: a pipeline monitor, pipeline designs, data-quality rules, dbt snapshots, lakehouse time travel, streaming windows and Airflow retries.

ml.label: Machine Learning
ml.intro: The projects' own trained models and the checks around them: an image classifier, an ASL sign recognizer, a forecast, a decision-threshold tuner and drift and fairness monitoring. Models download only when you press Run, then run on this page.

ai.label: AI & Language
ai.intro: Text tools: score a job posting against a profile, check a draft against writing rules, and answer questions by meaning with sentence embeddings.

demos.title: SQL Analytics Playground
demos.what: Write SQL against tables from four projects and chart the result.

demos.title: ETL Pipeline Monitor
demos.what: Run a pipeline and watch latency, reliability and drift checks.

demos.title: A/B Test Significance
demos.what: Simulate an experiment or test your own visitor and conversion counts with a z-test.

demos.title: Model Threshold Tuner
demos.what: Move a model's decision threshold, or paste your own scores and costs, and find the best one.

demos.title: Pipeline Architecture Explorer
demos.what: Walk through real pipeline designs, step by step.

demos.title: Job Description Fit Scorer
demos.what: Paste a job posting and get the rule-based fit score Career Pilot uses.

demos.title: Data Contract Checker
demos.what: Paste CSV rows and run data-quality rules against them.

demos.title: SCD Type 2 Snapshots
demos.what: See how a dbt snapshot keeps history that a merge throws away.

demos.title: Drift & Fairness Monitor
demos.what: Shift a model's inputs, or paste your own two columns, and see which drift and fairness checks fail.

demos.title: Lakehouse Time Travel
demos.what: Query a table as it was at an earlier version.

demos.title: Event-Time Windows
demos.what: Set a watermark and lateness and watch late events land or drop.

demos.title: Airflow Backfill & Retry
demos.what: Replay a DAG's retries and backfills day by day.

demos.title: Shape Classifier
demos.what: Draw or upload a shape; see each image-processing step, then the model's answer.

demos.title: ASL Word Signs
demos.what: Sign to your webcam or upload a clip; a GRU names the sign.

demos.title: Survival Curves by Dosage

demos.title: Benford's Law Audit

demos.title: Fraud Rule Tester
demos.what: Tune fraud rules on 345,524 transactions or your own CSV.

demos.title: LinkedIn Post Checker
demos.what: Paste a draft and run CurioSync's writing rules on it.

demos.title: Member Q&A by Meaning
demos.what: Ask questions answered by sentence embeddings, on members' messages or your own text.
